query: What field-experiment designs (survey or lab-in-field) most reliably measure framing effects of efficiency, social protection, sovereignty, or moral-economy frames on policy support and protest propensity?

response.query: What field-experiment designs (survey or lab-in-field) most reliably measure framing effects of efficiency, social protection, sovereignty, or moral-economy frames on policy support and protest propensity?
response.answer: Lab-in-field experiments most reliably measure framing effects on policy support and protest propensity. These designs manipulate frames in real-world settings to observe behavioral changes. Randomized controlled trials within these settings provide robust evidence.
